snapshots.description: Order summary on the post-order success screen. The order id (#ORDER-xxxx) and total are masked. The capture also includes the order-success hero, whose topographic LIVE-TRACKING map is an animated canvas with NO testid to mask, so the per-frame animation contributes a small (~1.5-2%) irreducible diff. The threshold is widened to 0.05 to tolerate that decorative animation while still gating real layout regressions (>5%); a future tightening could re-target the regionRef to the order-details section only.
Payment selector with the Place Order CTA visible.
